coder_notes: Single registered intervention 'PD-1 (other names: apatinib)' covers two agents: an anti-PD-1 antibody named Carilizumab (camrelizumab) in title/conditions/summary, and apatinib. Both arms receive both drugs; the randomised comparison is neoadjuvant vs adjuvant timing, so neither arm is a control. Inclusion criterion mentions 'first dose of nivolumab', apparently a template remnant; nivolumab is not a registered intervention and was not listed. Apatinib moiety given as INN rivoceranib; script mapping should confirm.
